steps.title: Define Project Requirements
steps.description: Establish the design requirements and target SDKs for the Modern Calculator app.

steps.title: Create Project Structure
steps.description: Initialize the Android project directory hierarchy including java source and resources directory structure.

steps.title: Configure Build Tools
steps.description: Write a Gradle build script targeting Compile SDK 34 and MIN SDK 21 compatible with Java 17 and Gradle 8.5.

steps.title: Draft Android Manifest
steps.description: Prepare AndroidManifest.xml specifying package namespace, application name, and launcher activity in full portrait mode.

steps.title: Design Round Custom Button Drawables
steps.description: Create shape selector xml drawables for styled interactive feedback on the numeric keypad buttons.

steps.title: Design Operator Button Drawables
steps.description: Create high-contrast active feedback selector xml shapes for operators like addition, subtraction, division, and multiplication.

steps.title: Design Special Actions Button Drawables
steps.description: Produce distinct custom selectors for the auxiliary features such as AC, Backspace, Plus-Minus and Percent.

steps.title: Construct User Interface Layout
steps.description: Author the main activity layout XML inside a weighted linear arrangement representing the modern responsive keyboard grid and expression display fields.

steps.title: Develop Mathematical Recursive Parser
steps.description: Implement a Java 8 compliant parser utilizing recursive descent algorithms for handling operation order, decimals, negative digits, and percentages dynamically.

steps.title: Implement Event Listeners
steps.description: Attach click handlers to numeric keys to capture and append calculations.

steps.title: Implement Operator Constraints
steps.description: Construct state guards preventing concurrent operator entry and handling sign changes correctly on the fly.

steps.title: Incorporate Backspace and AC Logic
steps.description: Add screen manipulation helper functions clearing full fields and deleting singular indices smoothly.

steps.title: Integrate Live Calculations Preview
steps.description: Build asynchronous/real-time calculator expressions compilation showing preliminary results as characters are entered.

steps.title: Error and Boundary Validation
steps.description: Incorporate safety checks for zero division occurrences, extreme overflow numbers, and string validation exceptions.

steps.title: Verify XML Namespaces
steps.description: Execute critical layout structure and relative path alignment checks inside the Android Manifest.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Run the automated Gradle compiler to package resources, parse layout components, verify syntax, and generate the signed debug APK.
